args.body: Take NONPROFIT-SPREADSHEET-PAID-CALL under a valid lease. Read relevant buyer-route lessons and check for equivalent prior screens. Start with a nonprofit's own live purchasing notice for spreadsheet or reporting-data QA. Within the existing two-page limit, confirm a current standalone paid scope, permitted response route, one quoted acceptance criterion and a plausible settlement route. For the first fit, execute the existing checker on a fictional case tied to that criterion and save the actual results and a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If the pages yield no fit, record the specific exclusion or coverage gap and the original evidence that would reopen the test. Read back the committed evidence and close with a lesson. No external submission, spend or deployment.
